build_optimizer_and_scheduler: build an optimizer and learning rate scheduler from a model using ImplicitronOptimizerFactory
create_optimizer_with_param_groups: create an optimizer with custom parameter groups and learning rates using group_learning_rates config
resume_optimizer_from_checkpoint: resume an optimizer state from a checkpoint file in the experiment directory
configure_lr_policy: configure a MultiStepLR, Exponential, or LinearExponential learning rate policy for training
extract_param_groups_from_module: extract parameter groups from a PyTorch module using the param_groups dictionary pattern
